title: NovaJet Aviation Group - Private Jet Charter

services.name: Block Charter
services.desc: NovaJet’s Helicopter Services provides a top-notch and unique experience to everyone onboard. Explore this safe, time-effective, and fun way to travel to your next destination. Our helicopters have landing privileges at airports, golf courses, private estates, or any helipad in southern Ontario. Skip cottage country traffic after a busy day at the office; Muskoka is only a 30 minute helicopter ride from downtown Toronto. You’ll arrive just in time for dinner with the family. Go ahead and maximize your weekend - we’ll pick you up again on Monday morning. Arrive in style at some of Canada’s most prestigious golf courses! Land at the course of your choosing, enjoy a round of golf with friends,
